remarks: Charming Cape on Quiet Cul-de-sac with Modern Updates. Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this charming Cape offers a serene retreat with numerous recent updates. The well maintained home boasts a newer roof, siding, and windows, providing both style and peace of mind. Inside, you'll find a spacious layout with 4 bedrooms and 1 full bath plus an additional half bath for convenience. The beautifully maintained hardwood floors flow throughout the main level, adding warmth and character to the home. Enjoy the outdoors in privacy on the screened porch, overlooking the level fenced yard-perfect for relaxation and entertaining. With central AC on the main level, comfort is ensured year-round.  This home also offers an ideal location with a great commute, making it a perfect balance of tranquility and convenience. This is an Estate sale,Home has been well maintained and updated being sold as.
